messages.subject: problem loading ggplot2
parts:
I've posted a couple of different places, and though I've gotten
helpful replies, I haven't yet solved the problem. I'm therefore
trying the ggplot2 group. I think my problem is unique to ggplot2,
rather than general to R, because I just un- and -reinstalled R.
During this process, I loaded a couple of dozen different packages and
only ggplot2 failed. Here is the problem and traceback( ). Thanks
for any help. Best,

p


> library(ggplot2)
Error in assign(names[i], dots[[i]], env = envir) :
invalid first argument
Error : unable to load R code in package 'ggplot2'
Error: package/namespace load failed for 'ggplot2'
> traceback()
2: stop(gettextf("package/namespace load failed for '%s'", package),
call. = FALSE, domain = NA)
1: library(ggplot2)
